notes: Historical discontinued record; this retained status and the historical fees, rewards and benefits are inherited from the existing record, not independently reverified in this provenance-only update. The issuer-submitted CFPB 2018_Q4 archive member "Pentagon Federal Credit Union/PenFed Premium Travel Rewards American Express Affinity Groups.pdf" explicitly names this historical American Express product. Another archived agreement names both Pathfinder and Premium Travel Rewards American Express cards; co-listing is not a conversion notice and does not prove transition to the current Pathfinder Visa product. Removed unsupported 2018-01-16 and replaced_by claims. Exact application-withdrawal/account-closure dates and successor remain unknown pending a dated issuer notice. Any current-product Source is a comparator, not evidence of a conversion; an archive quarter is not a discontinuation date. Card art provenance (checked 2026-10-21, secondary source, lower confidence): no usable official issuer image was found, so this is a local upload under the repo's option-C convention (image.provenance.source "other"; the sha256 is of the downloaded file). The source page is listed in secondary_sources. Match: black PenFed Credit Union American Express face with the vertical 'Premium Travel Rewards' legend, from WalletHub's listing for this exact card (the same design appears in a smaller capture on askmrcreditcard.com's PenFed Premium Travel Rewards review). The artwork remains the copyright of the issuer; it is for identification only and is not evidence of lifecycle or financial fields.
